name: TV DIABLO Windows
note: v3365: HEART: #24 sat unactionable across 27 events because every row said the same unusable sentence - the stage was open for 12s and had nothing on it - which records THAT nothing was there and never WHAT was there, the one fact separating a stage that never painted from one that painted where nobody looked. MEASURED on his real tv/ui_faults.jsonl: 200 rows, 8 carrying a before snapshot (4 percent), 11 ui_fault_record call sites, 1 passing before. A THREE-LINK CHAIN WITH THE MIDDLE AND FAR END BOTH CUT: ui_fault_record has STORED before since CF-4, whose own comment reads the reload destroys the only evidence; the /api/ui_fault route called it with kind why where and DROPPED before; the JS self-heal closed the stage FIRST and reported after. The storage end was built and waiting while neither end that could fill it did - the third instance of that shape in one day, after the second eye reach map and its record_answer callers. THE ORDER IS THE WHOLE FIX: removing theatre-open and setting hidden destroy the measurement, so a snapshot taken AFTER them is not a smaller snapshot, it is a snapshot OF THE DESTRUCTION - same fields, all zeroes forever, and it would look entirely correct in review. The order is pinned by POSITION inside the bounded self-heal block, measured at 708 against a hide at 1490. The snapshot records cards scrollH clientH innerH sessions thW thH scrollY painted loaded, because cards above zero with scrollH far above clientH is painted-off-screen and cards at zero is never-painted, and without both the row still cannot tell them apart. It is wrapped and records measureFailed rather than throwing, because a stage that cannot close itself is worse than the fault being fixed. HEART ROW fault evidence registered in all five registries. ⚠ IT READ MISSING THE MOMENT IT WAS BORN - 35 console faults in 14 days, none carrying evidence, every one recorded by code that could not yet send any. A TRUE sentence about the WRONG POPULATION, and a row that is red on arrival is furniture, so it now counts only rows after a historical boundary constant and answers UNKNOWN until a real fault arrives. ⚠ Two of my own instruments were wrong first: a red-proof that only appended a comment (inert, would have read BLIND against a sound case) and a key check where cardsOmitted still CONTAINS cards, so the sabotage satisfied assertIn - the substring trap, now comparing parsed keys anchored to brace or comma. Also the doctor row treated ui_faults_recent as a list when it returns rows and why. 484 gates, 7 cases, 4 red-proofs PROVEN.
